Lotus Root 12.4.16 · 17 Nov 2026

Pool links that no longer stall, faster block connection, Taproot addresses, one GPU miner

⬇ Download 12.4.16What is newQuick start
ImportantNapoleon, 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC: every node must run 12.4.13 or later by then. This version qualifies.
WarningGPU miner users: the lotus-gpu-miner-amd image and the -nvidia / -amd archives are no longer produced. Use lotus-gpu-miner for both vendors, and pass your own payout address: there is no built-in one any more. AMD cards were not tested on real hardware for this release.

Highlights

  • Pool links. Two pool nodes that connect no longer stop reading each other while both send their catch-up; such links used to stay dead until the ping timeout.
  • Faster block connection. The explorer and module databases are written after the block, in order, on their own thread: connecting a large block takes about half the time. -asyncindex=0 keeps the old path.
  • Batch submission and light templates. sendrawtransactions admits up to 1,000 transactions per call, 2.2 to 2.7 times faster than separate calls; getblocktemplatelight answers in under a millisecond.
  • Taproot addresses. The node wallet, the web wallet, the miners and the pool can create, receive on and spend from Taproot (lotus_J…) addresses. Legacy addresses stay the default.
  • One GPU miner. A single program and image for NVIDIA and AMD, with --backend auto|nvidia|amd.

Compatibility and rollback

Consensus rulesnone. The rules and the activation time are those of 12.4.13
Minimum version on the network12.4.13, required from Napoleon (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
NapoleonEvery node must run 12.5.1 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC. This version does not.
UpgradingStop the node, replace the binaries, start it. The data directory is kept.
Going backStop the node and put the previous binaries back. Going back is not always possible once a newer version has written to the data directory; the release says when.

Install and verify

Docker 
docker pull ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.16
docker run -d --name lotusd -v lotus-data:/data ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.16
Linux 
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.16/SHA256SUMS
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.16/lotus-binaries-12.4.16-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS     # must print: OK
tar -xzf lotus-binaries-12.4.16-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./lotus-binaries-12.4.16-linux-x86_64/lotusd -version
macOS

The same steps with lotus-binaries-12.4.16-macos-x86_64.tar.gz; check with shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS. macOS asks for confirmation before the first launch (the binaries are not notarised).

Windows

Download lotus-binaries-12.4.16-windows-x86_64.zip and SHA256SUMS. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash .\lotus-binaries-12.4.16-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 must give the value on that file's line. Then unzip.

Download Lotus binaries from github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases only, and check them against SHA256SUMS.
